On the calculator

Open FLASH in the Python app and choose your deck.

↑ ↓
Choose a deck or page through text
ENTER
Open a deck or flip a card
← →
Previous or next card
CLEAR
Back to decks or exit
Manual transfer

Send FLASH.py and your deck .py file to RAM with TI Connect Evo. In FLASH, choose Open by name.

Send a note

1–8 letters or digits, starting with a letter. TXT, Markdown, Word, OpenDocument, or RTF. Imports text for the Evo.

Calculator preview

Enter text to preview it.

Run the note by name in the Evo’s Python app. Up and Down scroll one line, Left and Right move a screen, and Clear exits.

Manual transfer

Download the note and send its .py file to RAM with TI Connect Evo.
